questions.stem: What does the acronym OIL RIG stand for in chemistry?

options.text: Oxidation Is Losing atoms, Reduction Is Gaining atoms
Oxidation Is Loss of electrons, Reduction Is Gain of electrons
Oxidation Involves Lattice, Reduction Involves Gas
Oxidation Is Liquid, Reduction Is Gaseous

questions.explanation: OIL RIG is a mnemonic for remembering that Oxidation Is Loss of electrons and Reduction Is Gain of electrons. This is one of the key definitions of oxidation and reduction in terms of electron transfer.

questions.stem: In the reaction CuO + H₂ → Cu + H₂O, which substance is reduced?
questions.explanation: Copper oxide (CuO) is reduced because it loses oxygen to form copper (Cu). Reduction is defined as the loss of oxygen. Meanwhile, hydrogen is oxidised because it gains oxygen to form water.
